نتسامح (form VI)
# نَتَسَامَحُ (natasāmaḥu) /na.ta.saː.ma.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
# نَتَسَامَحَ (natasāmaḥa) /na.ta.saː.ma.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
# نَتَسَامَحْ (natasāmaḥ) /na.ta.saː.maħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
